title: User Login with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that a user can successfully log in using valid email and password credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid email and password.
Click the login button.
Confirm user is redirected to the main app shell containing header, sidebar, and mobile tab bar.
Verify a valid session is created and credentials are protected.

title: User Login with Invalid Credentials
description: Verify that login fails when the user enters incorrect email or password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid email or password.
Click the login button.
Verify login is rejected with an appropriate error message without revealing sensitive information.
Confirm no session is created.

title: OAuth Login Flow with Jira
description: Ensure the OAuth authentication flow with Jira completes successfully and securely.

steps.description: From settings, initiate Jira OAuth login.
Complete Jira authentication and authorization in the external Jira window.
Verify user is redirected back to AxonAI with OAuth token stored securely.
Confirm Jira integration status shows connected.

title: OAuth Login Flow with monday.com
description: Ensure the OAuth authentication flow with monday.com completes successfully and securely.

steps.description: From settings, start monday.com OAuth login.
Authenticate and authorize on monday.com external window.
Verify redirect back with OAuth token securely stored.
Confirm monday.com integration status reflects connected.

title: Import Task List from Jira
description: Verify tasks can be imported correctly from Jira into AxonAI task list.

steps.description: Ensure Jira integration is connected.
Trigger task import from Jira.
Validate imported tasks appear in the task list with correct details.
Confirm no duplicates are created with repeated imports.

title: Import Task List from monday.com
description: Verify tasks are imported correctly from monday.com to AxonAI task list.

steps.description: Confirm monday.com integration is connected.
Initiate task import from monday.com.
Imported tasks are displayed accurately with correct attributes.
No duplicate tasks appear on repeated imports due to idempotent webhook handling.

title: Generate AI Daily Plan from Tasks Within Latency Requirements
description: Validate AI-based daily plan generation completes within 3 seconds at 50th percentile and produces a usable plan.

steps.description: Upload a representative task list to the system.
Trigger AI plan generation via API or UI.
Measure latency; verify it is under 3 seconds at 50th percentile.
Verify AI generated plan contains prioritized tasks with estimates.

title: Create Calendar-Aware AI Schedule without Overlaps
description: Ensure that AI-generated schedules respect existing meetings and do not conflict with user availability.

steps.description: Provide a task list and existing calendar with meetings and busy times.
Create an AI-driven schedule using the scheduling form.
Verify scheduled tasks fit around meetings with no overlaps.
Confirm the schedule matches user availability constraints.

title: Dynamic Reallocation After Mid-Day Interruptions
description: Verify that the system can reallocate unfinished tasks dynamically after disruptions to optimize the remaining time.

steps.description: Start with an existing schedule for the day.
Simulate interruption by marking some tasks incomplete or delayed.
Trigger dynamic reallocation of tasks.
Check that the schedule is adjusted to fit remaining time slots optimally.
Ensure no conflicts with meetings or availability arise.

title: Intelligent Task Breakdown with Estimates and Priorities
description: Verify that large tasks can be decomposed into subtasks with time estimates and priority labels.

steps.description: Select a large task from the task list.
Invoke the task breakdown feature to generate subtasks.
Verify subtasks have meaningful descriptions, time estimates, and priority levels.
Subtasks are displayed correctly in the UI and can be individually managed.

title: Calendar Visualization Displays Time Blocks and Events
description: Verify that the calendar view shows scheduled tasks and existing events accurately and is responsive.

steps.description: Load calendar view with a populated schedule and meetings.
Ensure time blocks for tasks and meetings are rendered correctly without overlap.
Check UI responsiveness across desktop and mobile screen sizes.
Verify calendar is accessible (WCAG AA) with keyboard navigation and screen reader support.

title: Analytics Page Displays Accurate Time Usage and Burnout Prediction
description: Verify that analytics charts show correct metrics for time tracking, efficiency score, progress, and burnout risk.

steps.description: Complete a work period with tracked tasks and events.
Navigate to the analytics and insights page.
Confirm time usage charts reflect real data from tasks and calendar.
Check efficiency scores and burnout predictions match expected values computed by AI.
Inspect charts for clarity, accuracy, and accessibility compliance.

title: Meeting Preparation Generates Agendas and Summaries
description: Verify that the meeting prep tool produces relevant agendas, pre-reads, and actionable talking points based on meeting data.

steps.description: Select a meeting from the calendar or input meeting details.
Trigger meeting prep workflow.
Verify that the generated agenda is contextually relevant to the meeting topic.
Confirm that pre-read materials and action prompts are logically sequenced and actionable.

title: Email Notifications Sent for Plan, Schedule, and Burnout Alerts
description: Ensure that users receive timely email notifications when new plans are generated, schedules are changed, or burnout risk is detected.

steps.description: Trigger generation of a new AI daily plan.
Verify receipt of an email notification with correct plan details.
Make a change to the user's schedule.
Confirm an email notification about the schedule change is received.
Simulate a high burnout risk scenario based on analytics.
Validate that a burnout alert email notification is sent.

title: Session Management and Secure Storage
description: Verify that session-based authentication is handled correctly and sensitive data is stored encrypted.

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials.
Check that a secure session token is created and stored correctly.
Inspect local storage and database for proper encryption of user data.
Attempt to access protected resources after session expiration.
Verify that access is denied and user is prompted to re-authenticate.

title: API Endpoint Error Handling and Telemetry
description: Verify all API endpoints return proper error messages for invalid requests and log relevant telemetry.

steps.description: Send requests to chat, AI planning, integrations, and notification endpoints with invalid data or missing parameters.
Verify that API responses contain descriptive error messages with appropriate HTTP status codes.
Check server logs or telemetry system to confirm error events are logged.

title: UI Accessibility and Responsive Design
description: Validate that all UI components meet WCAG AA standards and respond correctly on desktop and mobile devices.

steps.description: Navigate through all main UI pages including dashboard, tasks, schedule, calendar, analytics, settings, and help.
Test keyboard navigation for all interactive elements.
Use screen reader to verify meaningful labels and ARIA attributes.
Resize browser window to various breakpoints including mobile viewport sizes.
Verify UI layout adapts correctly without content overlap or cutoff.

title: Floating Chatbot Real-Time Assistance Functionality
description: Ensure the floating chatbot loads, accepts user input, sends queries to AI, and displays responses correctly.

steps.description: Open the app with the floating chatbot component available.
Click to open the chatbot interface.
Type a query and send it.
Verify that the AI responses appear in the chat window appropriately.
Check that the chatbot maintains context for follow-up questions.

title: Webhook Handling Idempotency and Reliability
description: Verify that webhook requests from Jira and monday.com integrations are idempotently processed and failures are handled gracefully.

steps.description: Send valid webhook payloads to the monday.com and Jira webhook endpoints.
Confirm tasks and data are updated appropriately without duplication.
Send the same webhook payload multiple times (duplicate delivery).
Verify system processes only once and ignores duplicates.
Send malformed webhook payloads.
Confirm that errors are logged and appropriate HTTP error responses are returned without crashing the system.

title: Support for 10,000 Monthly Active Users Without Architectural Changes
description: Verify system stability and performance under simulated load of 10,000 active users performing typical workflows.

steps.description: Using performance testing tools, simulate 10,000 concurrent users logging in, generating plans, creating schedules, and viewing analytics.
Monitor server response times, error rates, and resource usage to confirm system remains stable and responsive without scaling.
